historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission refused, 6-0, enlarging the mortuary here with a chapel and a five-stall garage and remodelling its exterior (Resolution 8612).
The Cathay Mortuary site here was proposed for a Chinatown park: the Open Space Advisory Committee voted for it on 14 September 1981 and the Recreation and Park director was to recommend it.
A resolution was introduced at the Board of Supervisors to begin eminent-domain proceedings to take the Cathay Mortuary's 13,500-square-foot site for a Chinatown park.

The Board of Supervisors' Finance Committee scheduled a hearing for 10 August 1987 on taking the Cathay Mortuary by eminent domain for a Chinatown park, after its owners refused a $2.75 million city offer.
